text:
maria: Quick thread — re: battlecard refresh vs cloud AI platforms + infra vendors. I sketched a one-pager (link) that leans into: predictable cost controls, unified runtime across hosted/dedicated/private, and fallback/reliability plays. Looking for 2 things: 1) what claims feel strong vs cloud providers, 2) what to pull into the webinar hook. TL;DR: focus on production economics and predictable SLAs. 

jake: Love the production-economics angle. For customer-facing battlecard we should have a clear 'When to choose Redwood' box: self-serve hosted for rapid dev, dedicated for predictable throughput, private for regulated. Keep copy < 6 bullets. 

sophie: +1. Also we need a one-line soundbite for the webinar: "Ship LLM features without building an inference stack" — too generic? 

dan: That soundbite is good. For enterprise sellers, add a quick competitive rebuttal: "vs cloud AI: superior latency predictability and cost controls; vs LLM APIs: predictable unit economics at scale; vs infra vendors: turnkey runtime + ops". Keep it < 30s. 

maria: @dan can you draft the 3 short rebuttals? We'll A/B test them in email + LinkedIn. 

dan: Drafted, pasted below. Feedback please. 

```
1) vs big cloud APIs — We match model quality but give predictable latency/SLA and lower tail-costs through batching/caching and routing policy.
2) vs pure LLM APIs — We expose the same dev ergonomics but add capacity tiers, reserved GPU pools, and private deployments for compliance.
3) vs infra vendors — You don't get to own the whole runtime + rollout tooling; Redwood delivers a tested runtime + rollout primitives so your platform team can standardize.
```

sophie: Nice. For the battlecard visuals, we should show a simple 2x2: Cost predictability vs Time-to-market. Redwood sits upper-right. 

sam: For routing inbound leads, propose mapping: interest=benchmarks/webinar -> SDRs; interest=private/dedicated -> AE with solutions engineer; interest=technical deep dive -> SE. Also tag leads with 'bench_latency' and 'deploy_model' in Salesforce. 

maria: @sam good. Add a play for 'benchmarks' that links to the benchmark report + 10-min self-serve demo link. 

ci-bot: Benchmark run 2024-11-03 uploaded: /releases/benchmarks/2024-11-03-latency.csv : mean latency 78ms for 4k context on p4dn (ci-tag: v3). 

jake: Perfect timing. We'll reference the run in the campaign: "real-world 4k latency: 78ms" — legal ok? needs sign-off. 

sophie: I'll queue legal review. Also drafting 3 webinar hooks: 1) "Predictable inference economics" 2) "From prototype to production: ops that scale" 3) "Cut token costs without sacrificing latency" — pick one for homepage. 

dan: My pick: #2 for enterprise, #1 for mid-market. 

maria: Action items: @dan finalize rebuttals by EOD, @sophie draft one-pager visuals + legal queue, @sam finalize inbound mapping in Salesforce, @jake prep campaign copy referencing benchmark run (hold until legal). We'll reconvene tomorrow 10am sync. :thumbsup:

sophie: noted. will upload drafts to the doc link. 

dan: done — pushed rebuttal copy to the doc. 

maria: thanks everyone. closing thread — will ping for the 10am sync. :rocket:
